'''Alchemist's Mark''' is a [[spell]] that [[mark]]s a single target with a [[curse]]. Hits against the marked target grant [[flask]] charges and when you [[ignite]] or [[poison]] the marked enemy, it leaves behind [[burning ground]] or [[caustic ground]] under them, respectively.

==Skill Functions and Interactions==
'''Elemental Proliferation''': [[ignite|Ignites]] that are [[elemental_proliferation|proliferated]] from a nearby enemy or corpse to the marked target will not trigger the burning ground.

'''Flask charges''': {{c|mod|Gain 1 Flask Charge when you Hit a Cursed Enemy}} grants charges to all flasks.<ref>https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/wpdoel/why_is_alchemists_marks_charge_gain_so_low_if/ikgaujx/</ref>

'''Proxies''': hits from [[proxies]], such as [[totem]]s or [[trap]]s, are unable to create this curse's ground effects.

The duration of the burning and caustic ground are independent of the duration of the ignite or poison that applied it, making it work well with builds that use high-damage, low-duration ignite/poisons.
